title: MOND from Second-Order Moment Modified Acceleration and Quantum Equivalence Principle
summary: This paper proposes a novel non-inertial quantum effect wherein particle spectra show second-order moment extra Gaussian broadening due to local short-time (non-uniform) acceleration, as well as in a deSitter spacetime background. Although the effect is too small to be detected, it provides a mechanism for the cosmological constant to enter the local kinematics of particles in the form of acceleration.
